title: Little Feet Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Little Feet is a 1 BR / 1 BA / 4 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. When an intimate cottage is all you need, the modernly designed Little Feet offers an exceptional, light-filled adventure.
description_expanded: Description61 EAST RUSKIN STREET1 QUEEN, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Little Feet | A Modern Seaside Guest CottageWelcome to Little Feet, a modern coastal cottage thoughtfully designed by renowned local Seaside architect Ty Nun. This newly built guest cottage to the main home Pitter Patter offers abundant natural light, clean architectural lines, and an unbeatable location—just seven homes from private beach access, one block from downtown Seaside, and quietly tucked along a shaded, sandy footpath that feels worlds away from the bustle.Outdoor Living & Front Porch CharmA charming, furnished front porch welcomes you with bistro seating for two, overlooking a private yard—an ideal spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind after a beach day. The peaceful setting perfectly complements the cottage’s tranquil surroundings.Open-Concept Living, Dining & KitchenInside, the open-concept first floor features the living, dining, and kitchen areas bathed in natural light. The living room offers a queen sleeper sofa, a cozy club chair, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and a Sonos sound bar. Across the room, a custom built-in dining nook with bench seating for four is wrapped in windows, creating a seamless connection to the outdoors.The thoughtfully designed kitchen includes custom open shelving and floor-to-ceiling windows, along with a microwave convection oven, two-burner Wolf induction cooktop, refrigerator/freezer with ice maker, and a washer/dryer combo. While there is no dishwasher, the kitchen is well equipped with everything needed to prepare meals during your stay.Upstairs Primary Suite & Private BalconyA spiral staircase leads to the second-floor primary queen suite, designed for comfort and extended stays. Custom built-in storage surrounds the bed, with drawers and dressers on both sides and additional storage tucked beneath. The bedroom also features a mounted flat-screen TV and a rocking chair for relaxing moments.The private en suite bathroom includes an all-glass shower with a handheld rainhead, vessel sink, and plenty of natural light. Just outside, the private balcony with bistro seating is perfect for sipping wine in the evening or enjoying a quiet morning coffee.Prime Seaside Location for Couples & Small FamiliesLittle Feet is a beloved Seaside guest cottage, ideal for couples or young families seeking a peaceful yet central location. Located just 85 feet from the beach and only a 2-minute walk to downtown Seaside, you’ll have easy access to over 35 shops and restaurants, all just steps from your door.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES504 Square FeetSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion — the largest private residential beach on 30A315 Feet | 1-Minute Walk to Beach AccessCharcoal GrillYouTube TV available for guest use2-Burner Wolf Induction CooktopFlat-Screen TV with Sonos Sound SystemMicrowave / Convection OvenWasher & Dryer ComboPeacock Alley Premium Linens — fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeQueen Sleeper SofaAccess to 3 Swimming Pools, 5 Clay Tennis Courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball Courts (court fees apply), and a Fitness CenterWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service Throughout Your StayStarter Amenities ProvidedParking Policy: Only 1 parking pass is issued per one-bedroom cottage; 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.STR23-002147
